editorial:
You're stuck at home with nothing to do, so you start watching your neighbors. That's the fun setup for this thriller. Kale is a teenager on house arrest who turns his boredom into a neighborhood watch mission. When a new girl moves in next door, things get interesting fast. The movie has a playful, tense energy that keeps you guessing from start to finish.

Shia LaBeouf carries the movie with charm and nervous energy. The pacing is snappy and the suspense builds nicely. Some plot points feel a little silly, but it's entertaining the whole way through. Great for fans of Rear Window-style thrillers. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: Kale discovers his neighbor Mr. Turner is a serial killer. After a tense chase through the house, Kale and his friends confront Turner. Turner is killed, and Kale's house arrest finally ends. The twist confirms Kale's suspicions were right all along, and the quiet neighbor was the murderer.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves neighborhood mystery thrillers
